description: Deterministic Koota simulation conventions for world lifecycles, independent RNG streams, safe traits, and world-scoped event logs.
rules: Keep world-generation and runtime-event randomness on independent PRNG streams.
Validate RNG parameters before drawing so invalid input never advances a stream.
Use factories for object- and array-valued traits; bare object or array literals are intentionally rejected.
Treat event logs as single-consumer: drain consumes, while peek returns a detached non-consuming copy.
Persist only the simulation header with snapshotWorld and restoreWorldHeader; entities and traits remain application-owned state.
Restore a world header atomically: validate the complete replacement before mutating its clock or RNG streams.
